title: Choose media picker shows whole pictures in a gallery-style grid
description: Fabio, 2026-10-16: the Choose media picker (js/components/Compounds/MpiMediaPicker, used by Flows and the + strip) crops every card to a square tile (MpiMediaPicker.css:141 object-fit: cover), so an 8:5 character sheet shows as one figure and two sheets look the same. Show each picture whole, in a proper grid like the Gallery's (read how the Gallery lays out mixed aspect ratios and reuse it, do not invent a second layout). Done = sheets, portraits and clips each readable whole in the picker; names still under each tile; filter, upload and pick unchanged; eye test by Fabio.
